lines.2: 「It is rare for someone to persist when I have been this cold to him.」
lines.4: 「Hehe... You wanted a date, was it? Very well.」
lines.6: 「You did place second in the class. Consider it a prize for valiant effort.」
lines.8: She really is a good person, whatever she may say.
lines.10: 「If you fell into utter despair and could no longer study, my superiors would reprimand me as your teacher.」
lines.11: 「This is simply aftercare in my capacity as your teacher.」
lines.13: Ms. Inori is such a fine adult.
lines.33: 「That attitude of yours... That's what drew me to you.」
lines.34: 「You let emotion wash past you like a willow in the current. You are never swept up in the mood.」
lines.35: 「That's what I've always wanted to become.」
lines.36: 「You are swept up in the mood at every turn, Tsushima.」
lines.37: 「I want to stop being swept along too, but I can't.」
lines.38: 「...Exactly! How can you keep that attitude all the time?」
lines.40: 「Like I said, I want to become an adult who isn't swept up in the moment... But I've also started wondering if that is really right...」
lines.41: 「You will never manage it while you remain so uncertain.」
lines.43: 「Why did you begin wanting to be that way in the first place?」
lines.44: 「I couldn't fit in with everyone. I'd charge ahead alone... Then I tried to save someone from being bullied, but I couldn't.」
lines.45: 「I was badly hurt and confused then. I didn't want to suffer that way ever again...」
lines.46: 「And now you have let the mood carry you away again and ended up here.」
lines.52: 「It has something to do with what's inside that locket, right?」
lines.54: 「How do you know that name...? Mr. Tsuchinaga...」
lines.57: 「It is already this late, and the test is over. Nobody should remain. Let us go to the cafeteria.」
lines.59: My throat is terribly dry in here.
lines.62: Bathed in sunset, we sit down in the cafeteria.
lines.63: 「I once had a sister I was very close to.」
